title: cases record and evidence add do not return the observation ID they recorded
symptom: A successful cases record returns only schema_version, recorded, outcome and provenance, and evidence add only schema_version, recorded and provenance; neither returns the observation ID, unlike cases run
trigger: chough cases record <case> ... or chough evidence add ... with exit 0
expected: cases record also returns case and observation, evidence add also returns observation, each equal to the recorded file stem and stored id (issue #60, REQ-cli-011, REQ-cli-017)
actual: observation and case keys are absent; automation must parse the ID out of the recorded path (KeyError: 'observation' in Kimi's runner)
steps: chough cases record TC-x --environment e --method manual --verdict 1=pass --summary s
Neither response has an observation key

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Both cases pass after the fix: the responses carry the IDs, equal to the recorded file stem and stored id.
